info.text:
I'm Jaisree Ramesh, a Frontend Developer with over 3 years of professional experience building modern, responsive, and user-focused web applications using React and TypeScript.

I specialize in transforming UX/UI designs into clean, performant interfaces, creating reusable component libraries, and delivering features end-to-end in collaborative, agile teams. My work emphasizes code quality, accessibility, performance optimization, and scalability.

I have experience working on real-world products such as dashboards, planners, and interactive tools, collaborating closely with designers, backend engineers, and product stakeholders. I enjoy solving complex UI challenges and continuously improving both user experience and technical implementation.

projects.title: Projects
projects.bespokeDesc:
A custom fashion platform where users design and purchase outfits tailored to their style and measurements.
Personalize designs, choose fabrics, and create clothing for any occasion.
Each order is made to measure, offering a personalized experience.
projects.rpsDesc:
A web-based Rock-Paper-Scissors game where users play against the computer.
Players select rock, paper, or scissors and see instant win, lose, or tie results.
The game provides interactive gameplay with score tracking. (Designs from Frontend Mentor)
projects.todoDesc:
A simple and intuitive To-Do list web app for managing tasks.
Users can add, view, and delete tasks with a clean, responsive interface.
It helps organize daily tasks efficiently with real-time interaction.
projects.memeDesc:
A fun Meme Creator web app that lets users generate custom memes.
Users can upload images, add text, and style captions in real time.
The app delivers an interactive and entertaining meme-making experience.
projects.timoraDesc:
A modern Pomodoro timer web app that helps users stay focused and organized.
It features task management, focus stats, customizable themes, and sound alerts.
Designed with accessibility in mind, offering keyboard shortcuts and screen-reader support.
projects.trackwiseDesc:
Trackwise is a client-side personal expense tracker that helps users monitor and manage their spending.
It features expense management, category filtering, and a sleek analytics dashboard with charts and summaries.
All data is stored securely in localStorage, offering a responsive and intuitive budgeting experience.
projects.upNextDesc: Up Next is a media discovery web app that helps users quickly decide what to watch next by exploring movies in theaters, streaming content, and curated podcasts.
